prompt: The whole left half of the image is calm, dark, deep open water with nothing in it, only quiet engraved wave lines, no object, no ripple. In the right third of the image, a hunting trophy adrift on the open sea, seen from slightly above: one large curved tusk of a great beast, made of old ivory, lying on its side and floating half-submerged, its long curve resting low and almost horizontal on the water like a piece of driftwood, the thick root end and the sharp tip above the surface while the middle of the curve dips below the waterline; the water surface cuts across the tusk and hides the sunken part, with a thin rim of foam strokes where the ivory meets the water. The tusk is never standing upright, never balanced on the water. Its surface is plain and blank, with a few long fine cracks along its length and some engraved hatching for the roundness. Close beside it float two smaller curved fangs, also on their sides and half-submerged. The three are tied together into one bundle by a thin dark leather cord wound around their root ends, and on the cord hangs one single round bead filled with burnt orange #E0703A. The tusk and the fangs are drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading; only the bead is orange. From the bundle, concentric ripples spread out across the water surface, drawn as fine engraved off-white lines in the water itself: wide flattened ellipses seen in perspective, much wider than tall, the nearer arcs larger and bolder, the farther arcs thinner and fading into the wave lines, dying out well before the middle of the image. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands of cerulean, darker and deeper on the left, bathymetric contour lines, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests near the tusk. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no gradient, no skull, no animal, no person, no hand, no carving, no symbols, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border, no frame. The engraved sea fills the whole wide image edge to edge. The bundle is medium-sized and sits entirely in the right third of the image with water all around it. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of burnt orange #E0703A on the single bead only.
